messages.subject: Onboarding kick-off — data sources
messages.plaintextBody:
Daniel,

Ahead of kick-off, our sustainability and finance teams are pulling together the supplier-spend extracts and two baseline years of activity data per the Statement of Work. Can your implementation lead confirm the SAP connector requirements? We're aiming to keep to the 9 February go-live.

Anita Shah
Head of Sustainability, Harborlight Retail Group plc
